newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK APRIL PROFIT 26.1 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK APRIL PROFIT 26.1 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Hansapank's net profit in April was 26.1 million kroons and the profit for 1997 is 122.5 million kroons so far, the bank said on Tuesday.
The bank also said in a statement that deposits in April rose 42 million kroons to 3.83 billion kroons, a 1.1 percent rise, with demand deposits up 82.3 million kroons to 2.92 billion kroons.
The bank said that it paid dividends of 23.9 million kroons in April and its shareholder equity only rose 2.2 million kroons to 798.5 million kroons.
The bank said that its net loan portfolio rose by 155.3 million kroons to 3.56 billion kroons.
It said a syndicated loan taken in March lowered the loan portfolio share of total assets to 51.2 percent and that its goal was to keep this ratio ar around 55 percent.
At the end of April, loan loss allowances amounted to 49.5 million kroons or 1.4 percent of the loan portfolio.

In April, the highest growth was in the securities available for sale portfoliom which rose by 89.6 percent or 319.7 million kroons. It said most of this portfolio was made up of OECD government bonds.
It said its market share at the end of the month was 27.6 percent in assets, 24.7 percent in deposits and 26.9 percent in loans.
